chemicals.songTitle: Lover I Don’t Have to Love
chemicals.line: Where is the kid with the chemicals?
stanza: I want a lover I don't have to love
I want a girl who's too sad to give a fuck
Where is the kid with the chemicals?
I thought he said to meet me here but I'm not sure
I got the money if you got the time
You said it feels good; I said I'll give it a try
